The '''CryoBan grenade''', also named '''cryo grenade''', was a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] that could temporarily freeze targets.

==Description==
[[File:Cryoban_grenade-EotECR.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] throwing a CryoBan grenade]]
The CryoBan grenade was originally designed as an emergency [[Fire/Legends|fire]] suppressant.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" /> It used [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]] technology adapted from the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]] process. Used as a weapon, the CryoBan grenade covered targets in its blast radius with supercooled chemicals, causing pain and temporarily trapping a person within the ice formed by the blast. The cold itself could also damage equipment such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]], electronics, and vehicles that were not adapted for cold-weather use.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

Models manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] included the [[WW-41 CryoBan grenade/Legends|WW-41 CryoBan grenade]] and [[WW-47 CryoBan grenade]]. These CryoBan grenades had a distinct [[Baton/Legends|baton]] shape.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the young readers novel ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'', written by [[Elizabeth Hand]]<ref name="Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref> and released in [[December]] [[2004]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>  CyroBan grenades are identified as "cryo-ban grenades".<ref name="Pursuit" />
